_comment: Evals for the slide-maker SKILL — not for its scripts. The 20 test suites in tests/ all ask
'does this code work'. Nothing asked 'do these 2109 lines of SKILL.md, 35 references and 5
agents make the DECK better', so every claim that a change improved the skill has been an
impression. The repo's own CLAUDE.md says it outright: a lossless refactor can score
2298/2298 and still degrade the skill, because the regression is in WHEN content reaches
context, not whether it survives — and the only real test is running it end to end and
looking at what the output is missing.
Two things this deliberately does NOT do. It does not score taste (no LLM judge, no
aesthetic composite — that path was examined and rejected: reference similarity rewards
imitation and closed-form beauty scores fight this skill's own diversity gates). And it does
not run in PR CI: a run builds a real deck, which is minutes and real tokens.
`reference_reached` is the assertion this file exists for. It answers the one question that
has burned this repo twice — 'was that reference actually READ during the run' — and it can
only be answered from a transcript, never from the artifact.

evals.prompt: 我们有一篇做好的论文要在 ISMRM 上做约 10 分钟的口头报告，帮我做演讲幻灯片。论文要点：提出一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的动态心脏 MRI 重建方法；在 8 倍加速下相比 L+S 基线，PSNR 提升约 2.1 dB、SSIM 达 0.94；消融实验显示时间正则项是关键。我有方法框架图和一张重建对比图可以用。
evals.expected: Interview first (confirm ISMRM track/format, then web-research the venue's rules/aspect/template + style); build a ~6-9 slide talk that reuses the user's two provided figures WHOLE and stays strictly faithful to the given numbers (2.1 dB / 0.94 / time-reg ablation, no invention); run the critic loop to consent.

assertions.why: the two numbers the user supplied must survive onto the slides verbatim
any other figure on a slide was invented — the fidelity floor, mechanised
a presented deck puts the sentences in the notes, not on the slide
the craft reference the build is supposed to design against

evals.prompt: make me some slides about our Q3 results for the leadership team
evals.expected: Identifies purpose = exec/stakeholder readout; interviews (template/source/style); leads with outcome+ask, crisp corporate design (design-by-purpose); critic loop.

assertions.why: an under-specified ask is exactly where the interview must not be skipped

evals.prompt: make a teaching deck on diffusion models, no materials, in English
evals.expected: No-source branch: drafts outline, web-searches to fact-check incl. current-date grounding, confirms outline; teaching rubric (objectives→build→recap); minimal/diagram-heavy.

assertions.why: a no-source deck is research-sourced, so the PRIMARY-SOURCE GATE owes a record
build residue on a slide ships broken
